app.name: Legal Baba
app.tagline: AI-drafted legal documents for Nepal, in minutes.

hero.title: Draft legally-structured documents in minutes, not days
hero.subtitle: Answer a guided questionnaire in Nepali or English. Legal Baba's AI drafting engine fills clauses, formats your document, and flags what's missing — reviewed against lawyer-built templates.

trust.title: Why AI-drafted documents still need a lawyer's review
trust.body: Legal Baba accelerates drafting using vetted clause templates and AI assistance, but it does not replace a licensed Nepali advocate. Every document is a draft — have it reviewed before you sign or notarize.

review.title: Review your draft
review.disclaimer: AI-generated draft — not a substitute for legal advice. Have this reviewed by a licensed advocate before signing or notarizing.
